convergence_parity.procedure: pre-registered Newton polish (tools/true_parity/campaign/run_R.R and polish_J.jl, CAMPAIGN_POLISH=1): R restarts nlminb at rel.tol 1e-13, then each engine takes at most max_steps Newton steps, stopping at the first point with gradient max-abs < 1e-5 and a positive-definite Hessian evaluated at that point; a step is accepted when fn <= f + 1e-12 * max(1, |f|) (a rounding-level rise, flagged accepted_uphill), and a step that raises the objective by more than that bound is not taken; every visited point is recorded in the raw polish files
